protocol.ndcg_gain: linear qrel gain, matching trec_eval/BEIR ndcg_cut (not exponential gain)
protocol.canonical_document_text: non-empty title, newline, text; identical input text for every retriever
protocol.bm25_tokenization: Unicode regex word tokens lowercased; no stemming or stopword removal
protocol.dense_similarity: L2-normalized vectors, exact exhaustive dot product
protocol.dense_latency_scope: warm exact ranking over cached document and query vectors; query embedding excluded and reported under index
protocol.hybrid_latency_scope: sum of measured component ranking latency plus measured RRF fusion; fusion-only also reported
protocol.dense_truncation: Full canonical input supplied; MiniLM truncates at256tokens and BGE at512. MPS uses explicit SentenceTransformer max_seq_length; CPU uses FastEmbed tokenizer configuration.
protocol.qrels_isolation: Test qrels select test query IDs. Relevance values are used only for evaluation after rankings; no qrel-based tuning.
protocol.query_document_same_id: excluded from ranking to match BEIR retrieval evaluation; FiQA has 55 test-query/document ID collisions and none is a relevant self-pair
protocol.bge_query_instruction: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
protocol.training_overlap_limitation: Pretraining/fine-tuning overlap with BEIR evaluation documents or queries was not independently audited; scores may reflect overlap.
protocol.hardware_timing_limitation: One local run using the recorded backend (MPS FP32 embeddings for this run; CPU exact ranking). Shared-machine index and latency measurements are not directly comparable with production Store timings.
